tasks.label: Build arm64 release APK
tasks.detail: assembleStandardRelease, the abi split is arm64-v8a only

args: $apk = Get-ChildItem -Path '${workspaceFolder}\app\build\outputs\apk\standard\release\*arm64*.apk' | Select-Object -First 1; $connected = (adb devices | Select-Object -Skip 1 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'device' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Split()[0] }); Write-Host "Connected: $connected"; @('55t445caskvcai5x','5c12eba1') | Where-Object { $connected -contains $_ } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Pushing to $_"; adb -s $_ push $apk.FullName /sdcard/ }
tasks.label: Push arm64 APK to device
